issue.title: plan-review: answer /ship --grill questions in the viewer, on a page of their own

summary: With `/ship --grill` in page mode, grilling rounds move from the chat to a /grill page of the same `plan-review serve`. /ship still runs the `grilling` skill but writes each turn (next round, replies to asks back, settled or replaced decisions, out-of-scope items, done) through `plan-review grill post` into W/grill.json. The owner picks a choice, writes their own answer or asks back on each question (drafts in W/grill_drafts.json), and submits the round at once; the server records the answers in grill.json and sends grill_submitted on /events. Decisions show beside the rounds; once the agent marks the grill done the owner confirms (or sends 'not yet'), and `plan-review grill decisions` writes W/decisions.md in today's format. The mode (page or chat) comes from --grill=<mode>, pipeline.json's `grill`, then a recorded preference (`plan-review prefs`), else /ship asks once. The chat grill and the plan page are unchanged. plan-review goes to 0.1.9 in this issue (`scripts/set-version.sh 0.1.9`), so CI's version guard passes; the GitHub release stays the owner's separate step.

steps.label: grill post ID W/grill-turn.json (round, decisions, replies)
pick a choice / own answer / ask back
Submit answers (enabled once every open question has a response)
answers next to their questions, asks into the thread, log += answers
grill post: replies beside asked-back questions, settled decisions, next round

nodes.name: Owner's turn? (handled == len(log), not done, not confirmed)
Exactly one response per open question?
422: name the questions without a response
Choice exists / text not blank / asks < MAX_ASKS?
Record answers, append owner action, clear drafts
plan-review prefs grill (pipeline.json grill, else preferences.json)
Exit 3: ask once, record with plan-review prefs grill <mode>, say how to change it
grill decisions ID, go to planning
First turn posted; plan-review serve ID starts?
Page grill: give the owner the /grill URL, arm Monitor
Chat grill exactly as today (remove a grill.json just posted)

edges.label: no (new or resumed: catch up with grill pending)

steps.label: grill post {done: true} (refused while questions are open)
grill_reopened {text}: done cleared, more rounds follow
Plan mode. Run ID. (server and Monitor keep running)
plan_changed: 'Plan ready -> open the plan' link (no auto switch)

tests.name: test_grill_setting_is_page_chat_or_unset
tests.behaviour: pipeline.json `grill` accepts "page" and "chat", defaults to None, and any other value is a readable error; `plan-review config` prints it.

tests.name: test_recording_a_preference_writes_preferences_json_and_ignores_the_folder
tests.behaviour: record() writes {"grill": "page"} to .claude/work/preferences.json, creating .claude/work/ and its `*` .gitignore when missing, and never overwrites an existing .gitignore.

tests.name: test_pipeline_grill_wins_over_the_recorded_preference
tests.behaviour: grill_mode returns pipeline.json's grill when set, else the recorded preference, else None.

tests.name: test_prefs_command_sets_and_prints_the_grill_mode
tests.behaviour: `prefs grill chat` records it; `prefs grill` prints the resolved mode and exits 0, or exits 3 with a message on stderr when nothing is chosen; a bad pipeline.json exits 1.

tests.name: test_the_first_turn_creates_grill_json_with_its_title_and_round_1
tests.behaviour: Posting a first turn with a title and a round writes grill.json holding round 1; a first turn without a title is refused with a readable error and writes nothing.

tests.name: test_a_question_needs_two_choices_and_unique_ids
tests.behaviour: A question with fewer than two choices, duplicate choice ids, or an id already used in any round is refused, one readable line per problem.

tests.name: test_submitting_records_choices_and_own_answers_next_to_their_questions
tests.behaviour: A choice (with an optional note) and an own answer are stored as each question's answer, the questions are no longer open, and one `answers` owner action is appended to the log.

tests.name: test_a_submit_needs_exactly_one_valid_response_per_open_question
tests.behaviour: Submitting with an open question left out, a question answered twice, an unknown question, a choice id the question does not have, or a blank own/ask text is refused (not a conflict) and changes nothing.

tests.name: test_the_owner_cannot_submit_while_claude_has_unhandled_actions
tests.behaviour: After a submit and before the next post, owners_turn() is False and a second submit is refused as a conflict; the same after confirmation.

tests.name: test_asking_back_keeps_the_question_open_and_the_next_turn_must_reply
tests.behaviour: An `ask` appends the owner's text to the question's thread and leaves it open; a later post that does not reply to every question awaiting a reply is refused, naming them; a reply is appended as Claude's.

tests.name: test_a_fourth_ask_back_on_one_question_is_refused
tests.behaviour: With three asks (and three replies) on a question, an `ask` on it is refused naming the limit; other answers on it still work.

tests.name: test_a_reply_may_revise_an_open_question_only
tests.behaviour: A reply with `revised` replaces the question's explanation and choices and sets updated; revising an answered question, or a question with no pending ask, is refused.

tests.name: test_decisions_have_ids_and_can_replace_earlier_ones
tests.behaviour: Posted decisions are appended; one with `replaces` marks the earlier decision replaced; a duplicate id, an unknown `replaces`, an already replaced target or an unknown question_id is refused.

tests.name: test_done_needs_an_empty_frontier_and_every_turn_leaves_the_owner_something
tests.behaviour: `done` with open questions, or together with a round, is refused; a turn that leaves no open question, no reply and is not done is refused.

tests.name: test_pending_lists_owner_actions_the_agent_has_not_answered
tests.behaviour: pending() returns the log after `handled`, each answer with its question title and choice label; a post sets handled to the log's length, so pending is then empty.

tests.name: test_confirm_needs_done_and_reopen_brings_grilling_back
tests.behaviour: confirm() is a conflict unless done and the owner's turn, then sets confirmed_at; reopen(text) clears done and logs the text; blank text is refused; nothing is accepted after confirmation.

tests.name: test_decisions_md_comes_out_in_todays_format
tests.behaviour: From examples/grill.json the output equals, byte for byte, a fixture in the format /ship writes today: `# Decisions for #53: <title>`, `## <topic>` in first-seen order, `- **<decision>**: <choice>` plus ` <why>` when given, and `## Out of scope` bullets.

tests.name: test_replaced_decisions_and_an_empty_out_of_scope_are_left_out
tests.behaviour: A replaced decision is not written (its replacement takes its place), and with no out-of-scope items there is no `## Out of scope` heading.

tests.name: test_grill_drafts_are_kept_per_question_and_survive_a_restart
tests.behaviour: put() replaces a question's draft, discard() removes only it, clear() removes the submitted ones, and a new store on the same file sees them.

tests.name: test_grill_post_appends_a_turn_and_reports_a_bad_one_readably
tests.behaviour: `grill post 53 turn.json` exits 0 and the round is in grill.json; an invalid turn exits 1 with `location: message` lines; a missing file exits 2.

tests.name: test_grill_pending_prints_whether_confirmed_and_what_is_pending
tests.behaviour: `grill pending 53` prints JSON {confirmed, pending}; exits 1 when there is no grill.json.

tests.name: test_grill_decisions_writes_decisions_md_only_once_confirmed
tests.behaviour: `grill decisions 53` writes W/decisions.md from a confirmed grill and exits 0; before confirmation it exits 1 and writes nothing.

tests.name: test_grill_schema_prints_the_turn_schema
tests.behaviour: `grill schema` prints the Turn JSON Schema (replies, decisions, out_of_scope, round, done).

tests.name: test_api_grill_returns_the_state_with_the_ask_limit
tests.behaviour: GET /api/grill is 404 without grill.json, else the state plus max_asks: 3.

tests.name: test_answer_drafts_can_be_saved_replaced_and_discarded
tests.behaviour: PUT /api/grill/drafts/{id} stores a draft (not announced to /events), GET lists them, DELETE removes one; an unknown or answered question is 404, an invalid draft or a fourth ask is 422.

tests.name: test_submitting_turns_drafts_into_answers_and_tells_claude_once
tests.behaviour: POST /api/grill/submit records the drafts in grill.json, clears grill_drafts.json and sends one {type: grill_submitted, answers: [{question_id, kind, choice_id?, text?}]} that is kept as the last event.

tests.name: test_an_incomplete_or_untimely_submit_is_refused
tests.behaviour: Submit is 422 while an open question has no draft (drafts kept) and 409 while it is Claude's turn or after confirmation.

tests.name: test_confirm_and_reopen_send_their_events
tests.behaviour: POST /api/grill/confirm sends grill_confirmed and POST /api/grill/reopen {text} sends grill_reopened with the text; both 409 unless done; blank text 422; Resend repeats them.

tests.name: test_pages_are_told_when_the_grill_or_its_drafts_change
tests.behaviour: Writing grill.json pushes grill_changed and writing grill_drafts.json pushes grill_drafts_changed on /api/updates.

tests.name: test_grill_is_served_and_root_redirects_there_without_a_plan
tests.behaviour: GET /grill returns index.html; GET / redirects to /grill while plan.json is missing and returns index.html (as today) when it exists, valid or not.

tests.name: test_serve_starts_from_grill_json_and_points_at_the_grill_page
tests.behaviour: With grill.json and no plan.json, serve starts, prints `plan-review: #7 at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/grill` and opens that URL; with neither it still exits 2; an invalid plan still exits 1.

tests.name: openQuestions, responded, canSubmit, asksLeft, answerLine
tests.behaviour: Unit: open questions across rounds; a draft whose choice was revised away counts as no response; canSubmit only when every open question has one; asksLeft counts owner messages; answerLine reads 'title → choice label (note)'.

tests.name: the grill page shows the round: explanations, choices with descriptions, recommendation first
tests.behaviour: At /grill each open question shows its title, explanation and choices with their descriptions; the first choice is marked Recommended; the page title shows the run label and title.

tests.name: picking a choice saves a draft and Submit waits for every open question
tests.behaviour: Picking a choice PUTs a draft; Submit answers stays disabled until every open question has a pick, own answer or ask back, then POSTs /api/grill/submit once.

tests.name: an own answer, a note on a choice, and an ask back are each one response
tests.behaviour: Writing an own answer, adding a note to a picked choice, or asking back saves the matching draft kind; choosing one replaces the others for that question.

tests.name: an asked-back question shows Claude's reply beside it and is updated in place
tests.behaviour: The thread beside the question shows the owner's ask and Claude's reply; a revised question is tagged 'updated'; after three asks Ask back is disabled with '3 questions asked; pick a choice or write your own answer'.

tests.name: drafts come back after a reload
tests.behaviour: With drafts on the server, a freshly rendered page shows the picks and texts and the right Submit state.

tests.name: the next round appears without a reload and answered rounds collapse
tests.behaviour: On grill_changed the new round appears below; the answered round shows one 'title → answer' line per question, and clicking a line expands it.

tests.name: settled decisions are listed with their question and replaced ones struck through
tests.behaviour: The decisions list shows topic, decision and choice with the question it came from, a replaced decision struck through, and an Out of scope section below.

tests.name: confirming makes the page read-only; Not yet sends a comment
tests.behaviour: Once done, Confirm and Not yet appear (Submit gone); Confirm POSTs /api/grill/confirm and the page shows 'Confirmed' with no inputs; Not yet with text POSTs /api/grill/reopen.

tests.name: a plan appearing shows a Plan ready link and never switches pages
tests.behaviour: On plan_changed with a valid plan the confirmed page shows 'Plan ready → open the plan' linking to /; location stays /grill.

tests.name: the grill page shows the Claude banner and Resend
tests.behaviour: After a submit the banner says it is waiting for Claude, turns red after 120 s with Resend, and shows Claude's status once set; the plan page's banner tests pass unchanged.

tests.name: the top bar switches between Grill and Plan once both exist
tests.behaviour: With grill.json and a plan, both pages show 'Grill · Plan' links with the current one marked; with no grill the plan page's top bar is as today (existing App tests unchanged).

tests.name: test_grill_mode_comes_from_the_flag_then_pipeline_then_preference_then_asking
tests.behaviour: The argument hint is `<issue number, issue link or prompt> [--grill[=page|chat]]`; step 1 names `--grill=page`, `--grill=chat`, `plan-review prefs grill`, the one-time question and the one-line hint on changing it; step 0 reads the input without `--grill`, `--grill=page` or `--grill=chat`.

tests.name: test_page_grill_goes_through_the_helpers_and_keeps_the_banner_answered
tests.behaviour: Step 1 uses `plan-review grill post`, `grill pending`, `grill decisions`, `serve` with the /grill URL, Monitor re-arming with catch-up, the three grill events, and sets `plan-review status` on each of them; with `viewer.open: none` page mode still uses the page, through its URL.

tests.name: test_resume_and_the_chat_fallback_are_described
tests.behaviour: A confirmed grill skips to planning; an unconfirmed one reopens the page and catches up; if serve can't start the chat grill runs as today with decisions.md written by hand; step 3 reuses a running server and Monitor and sets a done 'Plan ready for review' status before giving the plan URL.

risks.text: Assumed: `serve` starts when plan.json or grill.json exists (no new flag) and announces the /grill URL when there is no plan. /ship therefore posts the first round before starting the server, and if serve then fails it deletes that grill.json and grills in the chat, so the chat path still has no grill.json. That one delete is the only time /ship touches grill.json other than through the helpers: OK, or should a helper (e.g. `grill discard`) do it?
risks.mitigation: Existing serve tests stay (no plan and no grill: exit 2; invalid plan: exit 1); a new test covers grill-only start; the skill text spells out the fallback order.

risks.text: grill.json has two writers in two processes (the server on submit/confirm/reopen, `grill post` from /ship); a lost update would drop answers or a round.
risks.mitigation: Every read-modify-write holds file_lock and writes with write_atomically (Windows replace retry included); the submit holds grill_drafts.json then grill.json, never the other order, like review.py.

risks.text: A revised question can drop the choice an owner's draft points at.
risks.mitigation: The page treats such a draft as no response (Submit disabled, choice shown as needing a pick); the server's submit refuses unknown choice ids with 422 anyway.

risks.text: The banner's 'answered' check and Resend depend on /ship setting a status after each grill event; without it the grill page turns red after 120 s even though Claude is working.
risks.mitigation: The skill sets a status on grill_submitted, grill_reopened and grill_confirmed (and --done after posting), asserted by test_skill. The status and last event carry over to the plan review, so after the architect finishes in page mode /ship sets a done 'Plan ready for review' status (not --clear, which would make grill_confirmed look unanswered and turn the plan page red).

risks.text: The external `grilling` skill tells the agent to ask in the chat; it may pull /ship back into chat rounds.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 states that only delivery changes: each round the skill would ask goes into a turn file and `grill post`, and answers come from the page.

risks.text: Extracting useClaude out of useLive could change the plan page.
risks.mitigation: The Live interface stays the same and the existing ClaudeBanner/App/approve tests must pass untouched.

risks.text: Where does decisions.md's title come from? Assumed: the first turn's required `title` (the issue's title, or the name /ship gave a prompt), since a prompt's issue.md has no heading.
Assumed for decisions.md: a replacing decision is written where the replaced one was, the replaced one is left out, and `## Out of scope` is left out when nothing was deferred. OK?

The decision says Submit needs a response for 'every open question in the round'. Assumed: every open question on the page, since an asked-back question from an earlier round stays open while the next round is posted. Such rounds stay fully open rather than collapsed.
Assumed `plan-review prefs grill` with no value prints the resolved mode (pipeline.json, then preferences.json) and exits 3 when none is chosen, so /ship never reads either file itself. OK?
Outside this issue: the grill adds more POST routes to a server that does not yet block cross-site requests (#36). Worth raising the priority of #36?

CI's version guard (scripts/version-guard.sh, run by .github/workflows/plan-review.yml) fails any PR that changes shipped files while plugin.json still says the released 0.1.8. The owner decided to bump in this issue, overriding the decisions' 'no version bump'.
risks.mitigation: Run `scripts/set-version.sh 0.1.9` (plugin.json, pyproject.toml, uv.lock) and head the changelog entry `### 0.1.9`, as the 0.1.8 PR did; the existing test_the_plugin_and_its_python_package_have_one_version keeps the two in step. Tagging and the GitHub release stay with the owner (`release.sh patch` then releases 0.1.9 without another commit).
